The position supports technologies such as OSPF, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, IPv4/IPv6, network segmentation, resiliency, and high availability while maintaining flexibility to adopt emerging enterprise networking technologies as the University's needs evolve. Enterprise Connectivity & Security Engineer secure, resilient connectivity across campus, cloud, IoT and research environments by partnering with cybersecurity, enterprise applications, research computing, and external providers.
